title: sida grayana
intro: Sida grayana, commonly known as the Yellow Rattle or Rattle Weed, is a perennial plant belonging to the Malvaceae family. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including the treatment of various health conditions such as fever, rheumatism, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Sida grayana include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and expectorant properties, which help to reduce inflammation, prevent infections, and facilitate the removal of mucus from the respiratory tract. The bioactive constituents of Sida grayana include flavonoids, glycosides, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
